laws.rule: Hoge Kempen National Park (Limburg, about 5,700 ha, around As, Genk, Maasmechelen, Zutendaal, Lanaken and Dilsen-Stokkem): the accessibility rules approved on 25 June 2014 under a Flemish Government order of 5 December 2008 open all paths to walkers except in sensitive zones, which need the manager's permission or a ranger or approved guide. Breeding zones are closed from 1 March to 30 June. Cyclists, mountain bikers and riders may use only the routes marked for them. Dogs are welcome but must be on a lead, except in four marked dog zones where they may run free; in grazing zones dogs are not allowed even on a lead.
